svg.text: Idle sawmill: the plank saw (row 2), round 2: band saw and panel saw, by level
one flat band loop per blade; more loops appear as the saw levels up
the wheels are hidden in two blue cabinets, only the toothed blades cross the belt; level 1 one blade, 25 two, 50 three
the square log lies still; an orange bridge rolls along two rails over it, its mast carries 1, 2 or 3 flat discs; the cut layers lift apart (4 passes, 2 passes, 1 pass)
a gate over the belt; the saw head slides along its cross beam, its mast carries 1, 2 or 3 flat discs; the log is fed through step by step
